description:
Find the last public-transport connection tonight from where someone is to where they are going, the few before it, and what still runs after one in the morning (night trains and night buses), in Switzerland. When nothing goes tonight, the first connection after five in the morning.

Use it for "when is the last train from Zürich to Bern tonight", "how late can I stay in Lausanne and still get home to Vevey", "is there a night bus from Bellevue to Witikon on Saturday". A plain plan_journey search asked for a late departure lists what leaves after it, and one asked to arrive by midnight misses the connection that leaves at 00:02; this tool asks the timetable the way the night needs. For any other time of day, use plan_journey.

Inputs: from is where the person is, to where they are going home to; each is A station or stop name ("Zürich HB", "Bern", "Lausanne, Flon"), an address ("Bahnhofplatz 1, Winterthur"), a named place ("ETH Zürich", "Kunsthaus Zürich"), a town's name in English, French or Italian ("Geneva", "Lucerne"), a coordinate as "geo:47.3769,8.5417", or a place_id returned by find_place ("stop:8503000"). Names are read the way a rider types them; an ambiguous name returns candidates instead of a guess. departure is the earliest they could leave: Swiss local time in ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-09-26T08:00"; an explicit offset or Z is converted. A bare "08:00" means today (tomorrow if it has long passed). Omit for now. ("the last train tonight" from a dinner: the time the dinner might end, or omit for now). bicycle: true keeps to rides that carry bicycles; avoid_tilting: true keeps off tilting trains. Both are rules for the search, so it finds the connection that keeps them rather than striking trains out of the usual answer.

The regular service is taken to end at one in the morning, and the night at five: last is the latest connection leaving before one, earlier the three before it, after_1am everything leaving between one and five. When nothing leaves before one, the latest night connection is last. Connections that sit out the night at a station (a change of two hours or more) are left out. Times are planned timetable times with their Swiss offset; live delays and cancellations are not included.

Example: {"from": "Zürich HB", "to": "Bern", "departure": "2026-09-26T22:00"}

avoid_tilting.description: No tilting trains (the timetable's Neigezug note: on the 2026 timetable the IC5, IC51 and the ICN), for someone who feels sick in one; the search finds the connection without them.

bicycle.description: Only rides that carry bicycles: every train, bus or boat whose timetable notes say bicycles are not carried is avoided, and the search finds the connection that does without them. Rides where a bicycle needs a reservation or places are limited are kept.

departure.description: The earliest they could leave. Omit for now.

from.description: Where the person is now, or will be when they leave.

to.description: Where they are going home to.

name: last_way_home
title: The last connection home tonight
